# e2e coverage

An e2e scenario boots every workload on a live kind cluster — standalone
workloads directly, dependency-backed ones after provisioning a throwaway
postgres/valkey and minting their Secret. All are generated by `gen-smoke`.

**318 / 345 workloads have an e2e scenario.**
